appointment_lodged_on.description: The day BizFile+ acknowledged the appointment: within 14 days (s173A).

ceased_on.description: The day they ceased to hold the office.

cessation_lodged_on.description: The day BizFile+ acknowledged the cessation: within 14 days (s173A).

id_last4.description: An individual's identifier, its last 4 characters only (SEC-15); the full number stays in ACRA's register.

id_type.description: The identifier's type: nric, fin or passport for an individual; uen or foreign_registration for an audit firm.

kind.description: individual; or entity, for an audit firm only: a director, the secretary and the CEO are natural persons (s145, s171).

member_user_id.description: The member of the organisation they sign in as, if they are one: the named secretary holds the Company secretary role (FR-CS-06).

name.description: Their name as ACRA registers it.

nominator.description: Whom a nominee director acts for.

nominee.description: true: a nominee director, who acts on another's directions (s386AL).

officer_id.description: The officer it follows, by their first version's ID, with a version recorded: to record a cessation, a lodgement or a correction. Empty for a new appointment.

registration_number.description: An audit firm's UEN or foreign registration number.

role.description: The office: ACRA keeps the registers of directors, secretaries and auditors, and the CEO.
